text_block_list.text:
When we arrive at the training course with 
Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you hear? About Tama-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, I heard! That was it, right? 
Passing all 15 runners in a single sweep 
from the very back!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing~! With such a petite 
body, too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's true! I always thought she was a cute 
senpai, but she's so cool after all~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I feel like her expression was 
grimmer than usual. It was almost a little 
scary...”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going for a run.

With barely any warm-up, Oguri Cap started 
running. And as if her mind were 
completely elsewhere, she headed in a 
direction that wasn't the track at all...!

...No matter how much I called out, she 
didn't turn back. I hurriedly chased after 
her!

After frantically searching all over the 
place, I finally found Oguri Cap. However, 
someone was already with her—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So that's why things were awkward 
between you and Tama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You were just standing there frozen in 
front of a stump, so I got worried and 
came over...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, you really are just so clumsy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Urgh... I just don't know what I'm 
supposed to do."

Apparently, she had consulted the two of 
them about Tamamo Cross. Hearing that, I 
decided to keep an eye on them for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You two were very close, after all. I can 
understand why you feel confused.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we can't just leave things like 
this, right? If we're real pals, we gotta 
talk it out heart-to-heart!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Get... abs... straight down the middle!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' you now, I don't mean that 
literally! I mean hittin' ya with 
everything I've got in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I know. But... I don't have the 
confidence to convey it properly."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, it's quite all right. You don't have 
to worry about speaking perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Oguri-chan felt when she was 
called a rival.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do... is tell Tama-chan 
your true, honest feelings, Oguri-chan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"True feelings, huh... Tama once told me 
something similar back in the day."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ……Understood! I'll go talk to Tama!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Right, go get 'em! Tama was down by the 
riverbed!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good luck♪ I want to fight you... at your 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oguri! I told you, the riverbank isn't 
that way!
—I have to chase after them!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Shall we get our jog on, then?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait, Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, Oguri!? And...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's Trainer... ...ain't you breathin' 
way too hard? You all right?

I ended up having to use all my energy 
guiding Oguri Cap, who was displaying her 
total lack of a sense of direction at full 
throttle, but we managed to find Tamamo 
Cross safely.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, Tama. I... I...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —I'm so glad Tama's my friend!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy that Tama was the first to speak 
to me. And I'm so very happy that Tama is 
my roommate!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy you called me your rival!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But... I didn't know what it meant to have 
a rival to compete against seriously... 
And so, I ended up hurting you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But my mind is made up. ...I am Tama's 
friend.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And—a rival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I never would have imagined it until now. 
That I could have someone so special to 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's all the commotion about? 
Could it be... a love confession?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"No way, out here in a place like this? 
You've got some guts~."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...! Oguri, I get it. I get it, so just 
calm down for a second, okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't wait! I want to tell Tama 
everything I'm feeling!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Is that a public confession after all? 
I've never seen one in person~! Eeek~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama! I want to tell you—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold up!!!! Seriously, though!!!! Just for 
once!! Shut your yaps already!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I get how you feel, loud and clear. Or 
rather, you forced your way right into my 
head!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true...!? So you're not mad 
anymore?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah, not yet! I ain't satisfied just yet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
D'ya know why I stayed here instead of 
movin' on to the "Dream Trophy" where I 
could earn way more?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest of this era is Tamamo 
Cross!" —Unless I make 'em admit that, I 
can't move up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I told ya before, didn't I?! How are we 
gonna make everyone understand?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aah, what the heck, why'd you do that?! 
You ain't gonna get anything by playin' 
the good girl!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Win, keep winning, and rise to the 
top. There's no other way."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's only one thing I want from 
you. —A race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"You only really find out if someone's 
serious once you clash with 'em in a 
race."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' ya now. I'm runnin' in both 
the Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho...!

—Held in both spring and autumn, the 
"Tenno Sho." Boasting a long history and 
tradition, it is an especially vital race 
among the GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's up to you what you do, but make sure 
you talk it over properly with your 
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're still wheezing?! Just how 
hard did they make ya run?! I actually 
feel bad for ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's how it is. ...I'll be waitin' 
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho, huh.

As Oguri Cap watched Tamamo Cross's back, 
her eyes burned with a quiet fire...
